text:
deploy-bot: Starting staged rollout for release v3.4.1 -> geo sequence US then EU then APAC. Canary slice: 2% traffic.
maya: quick status: US warm pools green, EU warm pools +10% warmup in progress, APAC pool showing 65% capacity on g4dn-16x.
sam: APAC numbers look tight. Are those peak or steady? any ongoing batch jobs? :thinking_face:
liam: saw a background regen job on APAC autoscaler earlier, had a short spike 15m ago. Should be done.
irene: can we pin EU to previous model variant if we hit latency regression? need rollback plan.
maya: yes — plan is pin EU to model v3.3.8 if p95 latency increases >200ms for 3 consecutive 5m buckets.
deploy-bot: Smoke tests in US passed (basic generate + chat flow). Canary report: latency p50 42ms p95 180ms, error rate 0.03%.
sam: thumbs up on US. For EU canary canary-run scheduled at +20m after weighted traffic shift. We should hold APAC until EU is stable.
liam: agree. Suggest we also reduce APAC canary slice to 1% initially given capacity fragility.
irene: +1 to 1% APAC canary. Also set auto-rollback if OOMs > 1 within 10m or CPU steal > 30%.
maya: note: console alerting rule 'inference.p95.latency' set to page at 300ms, ops wants a pre-page at 220ms for this rollout.
oncall-bot: Alerting update: created pre-page alarm inference.p95.latency.prepage threshold=220ms scope=eu,apac. Owner=@oncall
sam: release notes snippet: "v3.4.1 runtime perf tweaks; kernel fallback for certain attention patterns; default batching tightened." Addendum: cost impact expected -1.5% token cost.
liam: small ops note — warm pool eviction window currently 10m; recommend extending to 20m for APAC during rollout to avoid churn.
maya: done. Warm pool eviction window extended to 20m for tags: rollout-1766504321 (APAC only).
deploy-bot: Starting EU traffic ramp to 5% now.
maya: EU canary observing p95 210ms -> above pre-page but below page. ops, please watch.
oncall-bot: Page triggered: inference.p95.latency.prepage EU at 212ms. Not paging oncall, ops monitoring channel.
sam: EU p95 is spiking on long-tail few models; rolling back EU to v3.3.8 now as planned.
deploy-bot: Pinning EU route to model v3.3.8 and draining canary v3.4.1. Change window note: rollback at +18m.
liam: EU pinned. Canary stopped. create follow-up ticket to investigate attention kernel fallback causing tail latency.
irene: APAC hold remains. Once EU is back on baseline for 30m we can resume smaller APAC canary (1%).
maya: agreed. Logging action items: 1) postmortem ticket #ENG-4892, 2) perf trace capture artifacts uploaded to s3://redwood-rollouts/1766504321/, 3) reattempt APAC at 1% after 30m window.
sam: thanks all. I'll update release notes with rollback line and send a short customer-facing blurb for anyone on dedicated instances.
deploy-bot: Rollout status: US: active v3.4.1 (canary -> 2% -> success), EU: pinned -> v3.3.8 (rollback), APAC: pending (1% hold). Thread closed unless new alerts.
maya: :thumbsup: Thanks team.
